entries.title: Genesis 44:1
segments: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men's sacks [with] food, as much as they can carry, and put each one's silver in his sack's mouth.

entries.title: Genesis 44:2
segments: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the mouth of the sack of the youngest, and his grain silver. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

entries.title: Genesis 44:3
segments: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.

entries.title: Genesis 44:4
segments: They had gone out of the city, not having gone far. And Joseph said to his steward, Rise up, follow after the men and overtake them, and say to them, Why have you rewarded evil for good?

entries.title: Genesis 44:5
segments: Is this not [that] in which my lord drinks, and by which indeed he divines? You have done evil in so doing.

entries.title: Genesis 44:6
segments: And he overtook them, and he spoke to them these words.

entries.title: Genesis 44:7
segments: And they said to him, Why does your lord say these words? Far be it that your servants should do according to this thing.

entries.title: Genesis 44:8
segments: Behold, the silver which we found in our sack's mouth, we brought it in to you out of the land of Canaan. How then should we steal out of your lord's house silver or gold?

entries.title: Genesis 44:9
segments: [With] whomever of your servants it may be found, both let him die, and we all will be my lord's bondmen.

entries.title: Genesis 44:10
segments: And he said, Now also [let] it [be] according to your word. He with whom it is found shall be my servant, and you shall be blameless.

entries.title: Genesis 44:11
segments: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and each one opened his sack.

entries.title: Genesis 44:12
segments: And he searched first at the oldest and with the youngest last. And the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.

entries.title: Genesis 44:13
segments: Then they tore their clothes, and each one loaded his ass and returned to the city.

entries.title: Genesis 44:14
segments: And Judah and his brothers came to Joseph's house, for he [was] still there. And they fell before him to the earth.

entries.title: Genesis 44:15
segments: And Joseph said to them, What deed is this that you have done? Do you not know that one like me can certainly divine?

entries.title: Genesis 44:16
segments: And Judah said, What shall we say to my lord? What shall we speak? Or how shall we clear ourselves? God has found out the iniquity of your servants. Behold, we [are] my lord's servants, both we and he also with whom the cup is found.

entries.title: Genesis 44:17
segments: And he said, Be it far from me that I should do so. The man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant. And as for you, you go in peace to your father.

entries.title: Genesis 44:18
segments: And Judah came near him and said, O my lord, pray let your servant speak a word in my lord's ears, and do not let your anger burn against your servant, for you [are] even as Pharaoh.

entries.title: Genesis 44:19
segments: My lord asked his servants, saying, Do you have a father or a brother?

entries.title: Genesis 44:20
segments: And we said to my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one. And his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loves him.

entries.title: Genesis 44:21
segments: And you said to your servants, Bring him down to me, and let me see him.

entries.title: Genesis 44:22
segments: And we said to my lord, The boy cannot leave his father, for [if] he should leave [his father], he would die.

entries.title: Genesis 44:23
segments: And you said to your servants, Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you shall see my face no more.

entries.title: Genesis 44:24
segments: And it happened when we came up to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

entries.title: Genesis 44:25
segments: And our father said, Go again. Buy us a little food.

entries.title: Genesis 44:26
segments: And we said, We cannot go down. If our youngest brother is with us, we will go down, for we may not see the man's face unless our youngest brother [is] with us.

entries.title: Genesis 44:27
segments: And your servant my father said to us, You know that my wife bore me two [sons].

entries.title: Genesis 44:28
segments: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces. And I never saw him since.

entries.title: Genesis 44:29
segments: And [if] you take this one also from me, and mischief befall him, you shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

entries.title: Genesis 44:30
segments: And now when I come to your servant my father, and the boy [is] not with us, since his life is bound up in his life,

entries.title: Genesis 44:31
segments: it shall be, when he sees that the boy [is] not [with us], he will die. And your servants shall bring down the gray hairs of your servant our father with sorrow to the grave.

entries.title: Genesis 44:32
segments: For your servant became surety for the boy to my father, saying, If I do not bring him to you, then I shall bear the blame to my father forever.

entries.title: Genesis 44:33
segments: And now please let your servant remain instead of the boy as a slave to my lord. And let the boy go up with his brothers.

entries.title: Genesis 44:34
segments: For how shall I go up to my father, and the boy [is] not with me lest perhaps I see the evil that will find my father?
